Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix broken blog reference links validation system

## Summary
Fixed the LLM enrichment service to properly validate and generate fallback links for blog references. Previously, some books with Google Drive URLs were falling back to direct Google Drive links instead of legitimate purchase/access links from Amazon or Google Books.

## Changes Made

### Backend Service Improvements (`llmEnrichmentService.js`)
- **Enhanced LLM Prompt**: Added explicit instructions for Amazon link format and fallback generation
- **Link Validation**: New `validateAndEnhanceLinks()` method ensures all books have at least one usable link
- **Case-Insensitive Type Detection**: Fixed sourceType comparison (book vs Book) 
- **Fallback Generation**: Automatically generates Google Books search links for books missing Amazon links
- **Amazon Search Fallback**: Generates Amazon search URL as last resort

### Reference Display Improvements (`references.js`)
- **Prioritized Legal Links**: Now strictly prioritizes enriched links from LLM over original URLs
- **Avoided Google Drive Fallback**: Prevents displaying Google Drive URLs for books that should have legal purchase links
- **Cleaner Link Logic**: Removed hardcoded manual link overrides (now handled by improved validation)

### Documentation Update (`CLAUDE.md`)
- Updated Knowledge Garden property documentation to reflect "URL" instead of old "Drive URL" name

## Results
All books with Google Drive storage now display proper Amazon/Google Books links:
- "Warren Buffett Accounting Book": Now has Amazon link (was showing Google Drive)
- "Et si vous en saviez assez...": Now has Amazon link (was showing Google Drive)
- All other books properly enriched with primary and secondary purchase links

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
